\begin{document}
We use the reduced energy
\begin{equation}
x \equiv \beta(\epsilon-\mu) .
\label{eq:x}
\end{equation}
The occupation of the level is then
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}+1} = \frac{e^{-x}}{1+e^{-x}} .
\label{eq:occ}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
